title: Surreal Beetle Queen
description: A woman in a black off-shoulder gown reclines on an ornate blue chaise lounge while holding a lit candle. Above her floats a giant beetle with antlers, golden rings, a goblet, and small white creatures against a dark background with glowing orbs.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene of a beautiful woman with short curly hair wearing a black off-shoulder gown reclining on an ornate royal blue chaise lounge, holding a lit candle in her right hand, above her floats a giant horned beetle with antlers, golden rings floating around it, a silver goblet, and tiny white creatures, dark background with glowing orbs and smoke, to the right an arched window showing a frozen desolate landscape with broken ice and a bare tree at sunset, intricate line art with selective color, mysterious atmosphere
